text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from sorting emails to checking data, which saves workers time. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees finish their work faster and with fewer mistakes. However, AI does not replace people completely. In fact, human-AI collaboration is becoming common, where people use AI to support their decisions and focus on creative tasks. This means many jobs are changing, and workers need new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI offers both opportunities and challenges in the modern workplace.
